run_glue_cola_task: run the Parlai GLUE CoLA task using the ColaTeacher class with --task glue:cola
run_glue_mnli_task: run the Parlai GLUE MNLI task using the MnliTeacher class with --task glue:mnli
run_glue_sst2_task: run the Parlai GLUE SST-2 sentiment analysis task using the Sst2Teacher class with --task glue:sst2
run_glue_all_tasks: run all GLUE benchmark tasks at once using the GlueTeacher multi-task aggregator with --task glue
run_glue_qqp_task: run the Parlai GLUE QQP question pairs task using the QqpTeacher class with --task glue:qqp
